text: China’s trade surplus surpassed $1.07T despite a prolonged collapse in exports to the U.S., as outbound shipments rerouted to the EU and ASEAN beat forecasts. The data exposes the limits of bilateral tariff containment, revealing surplus preservation through multi-node trade geometry even amid weak imports, housing drag, and rising global trade frictions.

meta.note: Pressure missed the load-bearing layer of global trade. Routes adapted without volume loss, exposing leverage decay and signaling compression before a broader multilateral response..
